title: Operational retrieval baseline — 3-character cafeteria conflict
intent: Standard OFF/ON comparison cast for the accepted authored index: Harley, Ivy, Magpie with cafeteria template for role_slots + premise retrieval.
opening_description: Arkham cafeteria at shift change: plastic trays, weak coffee, a guard's radio murmuring at the edge of hearing. Harley is wound tight; Ivy has claimed a table like territory; Magpie watches both, ready to side-step or steal focus.
trigger_text: A tray clatters—too loud. Harley's eyes jump to Ivy's hands. Magpie mutters, 'Nobody's eating until someone says what this is really about.'

seed_issue.description: Public space tension between three patients; staff proximity implied; no clean exit.
